title: Three Cups (ሦስት ስኒ)
logline: Through the three rounds of one coffee ceremony, a grandmother's life moves from a crowded village home to a quiet house, and her cup keeps calling her scattered family back.

style.prompt: warm hand-painted gouache illustration, soft film grain, amber firelight and morning light, muted earth tones of terracotta, ochre and deep green, gentle storybook feel, Ethiopian highland home
style.negative: photorealistic, text, letters, watermark, extra fingers, distorted face

characters.description: Ethiopian woman with warm brown skin, oval face, kind deep-set eyes, small silver cross necklace, white cotton netela shawl with a thin green, yellow and red woven border (tilet). Age is given per shot: young (about 20, black braided hair), middle (about 40, hair under a headscarf), old (about 75, silver braids).
Two Ethiopian children, a girl about 8 in a simple yellow dress and a boy about 6 in a white shirt, playful and curious.

props.description: one traditional Ethiopian coffee pot made from matte-black handmade clay, with the same round bulbous body, narrow neck, short side spout and small loop handle in every shot

music.prompt: slow, warm Ethiopian instrumental, krar and masinko with soft kebero, tizita mode, nostalgic and tender, gentle build then calm resolution

shots.reason: Opens on the ritual itself so the audience instantly recognises the coffee ceremony and feels at home.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of green coffee beans roasting in a black clay pan over glowing charcoal, thin smoke rising, grass-strewn floor at the edge of frame
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, smoke curling upward, embers flickering

narration.text: በቤታችን ውስጥ ሁሉም ታሪክ የሚጀምረው በቡና ነው።
narration.english: In our home, every story begins with coffee.

shots.reason: Introduces the grandmother young, so the later shots of her ageing carry weight.
shots.image_prompt: young grandmother, about 20, black braided hair, kneeling by a charcoal stove in a round village house with mud walls, shaking a clay pan of coffee beans, morning light through the doorway
shots.motion_prompt: gentle side pan, her hands shaking the pan, light shifting

narration.text: አያቴ ወጣት ሳለች፣ በመንደሯ ቡናን በእሳት ላይ ትቆላ ነበር።
narration.english: When my grandmother was young, she roasted coffee over the fire in her village.

shots.reason: Shows coffee as what gathers people, and names the first cup so the three-cup structure is clear.
shots.image_prompt: young grandmother pouring coffee from the same traditional Ethiopian jebena: a matte-black handmade clay pot with a round bulbous body, narrow neck, short side spout and small loop handle; into small white cups on a wooden tray, neighbours sitting around her on low stools, smoke from frankincense; no metal or modern coffee pot
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull-back revealing the neighbours, coffee pouring in a thin stream

narration.text: የቡናው ሽታ ጎረቤቶችን ሁሉ ይጠራ ነበር። ይህ አቦል ነው፣ የመጀመሪያው ስኒ።
narration.english: The smell of coffee called all the neighbours. This is abol, the first cup.

shots.reason: Moves time forward; same jebena, now with her own children, linking generations through one object.
shots.image_prompt: middle-aged grandmother, about 40, hair under a headscarf, sitting beside the same matte-black traditional Ethiopian clay jebena with a round bulbous body, narrow neck, short side spout and small loop handle, while two children lean on her shoulders, warm evening light; no metal or modern coffee pot
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, children shifting and smiling

narration.text: ከዚያም ልጆቿ መጡ። በዚያው ጀበና ዙሪያ አደጉ።
narration.english: Then her children came. They grew up around the same jebena.

shots.reason: The second cup is the joyful peak; the audience should smile before the loss that follows.
shots.image_prompt: children laughing and eating popcorn from a woven basket, middle-aged grandmother pouring the second round from the same matte-black traditional Ethiopian clay jebena with a round bulbous body, narrow neck, short side spout and small loop handle, frankincense smoke, lively warm home; no metal or modern coffee pot
shots.motion_prompt: playful handheld feel, popcorn tossed, laughter

narration.text: ቶና፣ ሁለተኛው ስኒ፣ የሳቅና የወሬ ጊዜ ነበር።
narration.english: Tona, the second cup, was a time of laughter and stories.

shots.reason: The turning point: the family scatters, the feeling the diaspora audience knows well.
shots.image_prompt: grandmother, about 50, standing at the gate of her house waving goodbye as a minibus drives away down a dusty road, long shadows at sunset
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull-back, minibus shrinking into the distance, dust drifting

narration.text: አንድ ቀን ልጆቿ ሩቅ ሄዱ። ቤቱ ጸጥ አለ።
narration.english: One day her children went far away. The house fell silent.

shots.reason: Shows her persistence; the ritual continues even alone, which sets up the ending.
shots.image_prompt: old grandmother, about 75, silver braids, alone by the charcoal stove, roasting beans, one single white cup on the tray, soft blue dawn light
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, smoke rising, stillness

narration.english: But she never stopped making coffee.

shots.reason: Bridges old and new: technology brings the family back into the ritual, the hopeful turn.
shots.image_prompt: old grandmother smiling at a smartphone propped beside the same matte-black traditional Ethiopian clay jebena with a round bulbous body, narrow neck, short side spout and small loop handle, screen glowing with faces of grandchildren, coffee cups on the tray, warm light returning; no metal or modern coffee pot
shots.motion_prompt: gentle orbit around her, screen light flickering on her face

narration.english: Today her grandchildren join her by phone.

shots.reason: The third cup, the blessing, is the emotional climax and completes the three-cup structure.
shots.image_prompt: old grandmother raising her hands in blessing over the third cup of coffee, eyes closed, the same matte-black traditional Ethiopian clay jebena with a round bulbous body, narrow neck, short side spout and small loop handle visible beside the cups, frankincense smoke glowing in golden light; no metal or modern coffee pot
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in on her face and hands, smoke drifting upward

narration.text: በረካ፣ ሦስተኛው ስኒ፣ የምርቃት ስኒ ነው።
narration.english: Bereka, the third cup, is the cup of blessing.

shots.reason: Ends on the motif, a full cup waiting, so viewers leave wanting to call their own grandmother.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of one full white coffee cup on a wooden tray beside the same matte-black traditional Ethiopian clay jebena with a round bulbous body, narrow neck, short side spout and small loop handle, thin steam rising, empty low stool beside it, warm golden light; no metal or modern coffee pot
shots.motion_prompt: static frame, steam rising slowly, light gently fading

narration.english: Even when we are far away, her cup is always waiting for us.
